step1_analysis.circuit_type: Passive Input Matching Network (Chebyshev Filter) for UWB LNA
step1_analysis.description: A three-section band-pass Chebyshev filter used as the input matching network for an ultrawideband (3.1-10.6 GHz) low-noise amplifier. It absorbs the parasitic capacitances of the input transistor (Cgs, Cgd) and source degeneration components to achieve broadband matching.

paper_reference.title: An Ultrawideband CMOS Low-Noise Amplifier for 3.1–10.6-GHz Wireless Receivers

Input_Match_S11.description: Input return loss (S11) over the UWB frequency band. The paper reports an input match of 10 dB (meaning S11 < -10 dB).

sky130_expected.calculation: S11 = 20*log10(abs(V(Vin)-1)) with 2V AC source and 50-ohm Rs.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The filter is designed to provide < -10 dB input match across 3.1 to 10.6 GHz.

Passive_Voltage_Gain.description: Voltage gain from the input source to the intrinsic gate-source terminals of the LNA transistor (N7 to N0).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Passive matching networks typically provide a voltage step-up (Q-factor) which contributes to the overall LNA gain and noise figure.

Power_Gain.description: Overall power gain of the LNA (S21).

sky130_expected.calculation: N/A for this passive sub-circuit. For full LNA, measured via S-parameters.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be similar to the paper's reported value when the full LNA is simulated.

Noise_Figure.description: Minimum noise figure over the band.

sky130_expected.calculation: N/A for this passive sub-circuit. For full LNA, measured via noise analysis.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 130nm CMOS has slightly better fT than 180nm, so NF might be slightly lower or comparable.
Linearity depends on the active devices and bias, expected to be in the same range.

Power_Consumption.description: DC power consumption of the LNA.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Power consumption is determined by the bias current of the active stages.

Bandwidth.description: Operating frequency range where S11 < -10 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: Measure frequencies where S11 crosses -10 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The UWB standard requires operation from 3.1 to 10.6 GHz.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the input return loss (S11) and passive voltage gain of the Chebyshev filter matching network.
